title: nephrodium filix-mas var. cochleatum
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas var. cochleatum, commonly known as Lady's fern, is a variety of the fern plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which may help alleviate various conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Lady's fern are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, lower blood pressure, and possess antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
